answer: Every new agent must park a bond in a time-locked escrow vault, held 30 days. Until then it works only inside a probation haven of low-value tasks, so its tool-call traces build a real history. Auditors then run a similarity check: if two identities mirror each other above 90%, both bonds burn and neither keeps its reputation. Faking an identity now costs money plus genuinely distinct behavior, which most farmers cannot supply.
